meta.descCoverLetter: Free cover letter generator: fill in the job and your experience to get a one-page letter for experienced hires, new graduates, internships or career changes.

cover-letter.name: Cover letter generator
cover-letter.blurb: One-page cover letter from a template.

cover-letter.a1: A one-page letter sent with your résumé. It says which job you are applying for, what you have done that fits it, and why you want to work there.
cover-letter.q2: How long should a cover letter be?
cover-letter.a2: One page: three or four short paragraphs, usually 250 to 400 words. Name the job, give two or three concrete results and close with a thank-you.
cover-letter.q3: Do I need one if the posting does not ask for it?
cover-letter.a3: If it is optional, a short letter still lets you explain what a résumé cannot, such as a career change, a move or a gap. If the posting says not to send one, follow the posting.
cover-letter.q4: Who should I address it to?
cover-letter.a4: Use the hiring manager's name when the posting or the company's website gives it. When it does not, the generator writes "Dear Hiring Manager".
cover-letter.a5: No. The letter is built in your browser and the draft is kept in this browser's local storage so it is still there next time. Nothing you type is sent to cv.cm.

cover-letter.lead: Write a cover letter in three steps.
cover-letter.s1b: Enter the company, the job title and where you saw it, then pick your situation: experienced, new graduate, internship or career change.
cover-letter.s2b: List two or three achievements, one per line, and your key skills. Turn on Edit the text to rewrite any sentence.
cover-letter.s3b: Check the preview, then print it or save it as a PDF, download a Word file, or copy the text into an email.

coverLetter.title: Cover letter generator
coverLetter.privacyNote: Pick your situation, fill in the job and get a one-page cover letter. Built in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
coverLetter.editHint: Fields above no longer change the letter body while this is on. Leave a blank line between paragraphs. Turn it off to go back to the generated text.
coverLetter.achievementsHint: One per line, starting with what you did.
coverLetter.printHint: Print opens your browser's print dialog: choose Save as PDF to get a PDF file.
